title: BeautyGuard: Designing a Multi-Agent Roundtable System for Proactive Beauty Tech Compliance through Stakeholder Collaboration

bias_targets.methodology: The paper evaluates fairness and bias risks in AI-driven beauty tech product proposals (such as intelligent color matching and shade recommendations) using a multi-agent LLM roundtable system. The system flags skin-tone fairness issues by cross-referencing domain-specific compliance checklists and retrieving regulatory precedents.

The multi-agent system assesses general algorithmic discrimination and bias in AI beauty consultant proposals by analyzing product features against automated 'Red Line' and 'Beyond-the-Rules' regulatory compliance checks.
